question.en: What was 'sweet as honey' and why?
question.zh: 什么东西“像蜜一样甜”，为什么？

sentences.en: What was 'sweet as honey' and why?
sentences.zh: 什么东西“像蜜一样甜”，为什么？

sentences.en: In 1963 a Lancaster bomber crashed on Wallis Island,
sentences.zh: 1963年，一架兰开斯特轰炸机在瓦利斯岛坠毁，

sentences.en: a remote place in the South Pacific, a long way west of Samoa.
sentences.zh: 那是南太平洋上一个偏僻的地方，位于萨摩亚群岛以西很远。

sentences.en: The plane wasn't too badly damaged,
sentences.zh: 飞机损坏得并不太厉害，

sentences.en: but over the years the crash was forgotten and the wreck remained undisturbed.
sentences.zh: 但多年来这次坠机被人遗忘，残骸一直没有人动过。

sentences.en: Then in 1989, twenty-six years after the crash,
sentences.zh: 后来到了1989年，也就是坠机26年后，

chunks.x: Then in 1989 twenty six years after the crash

sentences.en: the plane was accidentally rediscovered in an aerial survey of the island.
sentences.zh: 在对这个岛进行航空测量时偶然重新发现了这架飞机。

chunks.x: in an aerial survey of the island

sentences.pat: 非完整句（碎片/解析待核）

sentences.en: a Lancaster bomber in reasonable condition was rare and worth rescuing.
sentences.zh: 状况尚好的兰开斯特轰炸机已很罕见，值得拯救。

sentences.en: The French authorities had the plane packaged and moved in parts back to France.
sentences.zh: 法国当局把飞机包装起来，拆成部件运回法国。

chunks.x: the plane packaged and moved in parts back to France

sentences.en: Now a group of enthusiasts are going to have the plane restored.
sentences.zh: 现在一批爱好者准备把飞机修复。

sentences.en: It has four Rolls-Royce Merlin engines but the group will need to have only three of them rebuilt.
sentences.zh: 飞机有四台罗尔斯·罗伊斯“梅林”发动机，但他们只需要修复其中三台。

sentences.en: Imagine their surprise and delight when they broke open the packing cases
sentences.zh: 想象一下他们撬开包装箱时惊喜的心情，

chunks.x: when they broke open the packing cases

sentences.en: and found that the fourth engine was sweet as honey--still in perfect condition.
sentences.zh: 他们发现第四台发动机像蜜一样甜——仍处于完好状态。

chunks.x: that the fourth engine was sweet as honey still in perfect condition

sentences.en: A colony of bees had turned the engine into a hive and it was totally preserved in beeswax!
sentences.zh: 一群蜜蜂把发动机变成了蜂巢，它被蜂蜡完整地保存了下来！
